(2) L67, trailing clause of the What-happened block: 'The module's close sharpens it from what the invocation showed.' The block already completes check_writing.md §16's three-move shape at 'Shipped.'; this fourth clause's subject ('The module's close') and predicate both name a later beat's job. Harm: cartography with a friendlier face — both clauses bind this file to a shape a later beat (this module's own close, or the M4 module file) may not take, and go stale silently if that beat's design changes without anyone re-reading this exercise.
